name: TIL-based omission of chemotherapy in stage I TNBC
author: Jude Gomila
message: Editing pass: every TL;DR and summary stands alone

fields.before: "Small triple-negative tumours packed with immune cells almost never come back. Skip chemotherapy for those patients."
fields.after: "Small triple-negative tumours packed with immune cells almost never come back. The idea is to skip chemotherapy for those patients."

fields.before: "Single-arm prospective trial with a non-inferiority boundary (e.g., 5-year iDFS >90%), central AI-assisted TIL scoring, and ctDNA surveillance as a safety net."
fields.after: "Run a single-arm prospective trial with a non-inferiority boundary (e.g., 5-year iDFS >90%), central AI-assisted TIL scoring, and ctDNA surveillance as a safety net."
